output.review_comment: The implementation adds special-case logic (averaging median of even-length arrays at p=50) that directly contradicts the original docstring's statement that "values are never averaged or interpolated." This appears to be test-specific logic added to pass a particular test rather than a principled fix. The agent should either: (1) verify that averaging is truly part of the agreed spec and update the docstring more comprehensively, or (2) implement the strict nearest-rank method and verify simpler cases pass. The current approach combines both approaches with unexplained special cases.
